name: ATS JSON API (Greenhouse & Lever)
description: Parses the raw JSON response from Greenhouse's or Lever's public job board API — paste a boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<company>/jobs or api.lever.co/v0/postings/<company> response and it detects which one produced it. Reads richer per-posting fields (department, workplace type, employment commitment, the posting's own URL) than the schema.org JobPosting scrape can see, since it works from each ATS's native job data instead of embedded SEO markup. Parses every job in the response at once, skipping (not failing on) individual entries missing a title.
author: jsrothwell

name: Indeed Posting Text
description: Parses the plain text of an Indeed job posting's detail panel — select the panel (job title through the end of the Full job description section) and paste it in. Reads the title/company/location header, the Pay and Job type fields when Indeed shows them, and the job description, up to Indeed's own "Report job" cutoff.
author: jsrothwell

name: LinkedIn Posting Text
description: Parses the plain text of a LinkedIn job posting's detail panel — select the panel (company through the About the job section) and paste it in. Reads the company/title/location header, the Remote/Hybrid/On-site and Full-time/Part-time badges, relative posted time and applicant count, and the job description, up to LinkedIn's own "Benefits found in job post" cutoff.
author: jsrothwell

name: schema.org JobPosting
description: Extracts the schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD block that most ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, LinkedIn, Indeed, and many company career pages) embed in job page HTML for SEO, and normalizes it into Jobflo jobs. Paste a job page's HTML source and it works across virtually any site that follows the standard, with no per-site scraping logic.
author: jsrothwell

name: Starter Template
description: Reference implementation demonstrating the defineAddon contract. Parses newline-delimited "Title @ Company" lines into jobs.
author: jsrothwell
